doc_friction.issue: Says nothing about the interpreter: the bare python3 in cloud sessions is 3.11 but CI runs 3.12, and checks such as check_py311_syntax.py take a different path on each. My first pool bench ran under 3.11 and gave different numbers (80 s against 64 s under 3.12).

Step 2's ci_profile reading points at whole steps. Finding that the ventures-tests step is mostly unwired_checks time needed a job log (get_job_logs); a line saying 'open one job log of the heaviest step' would save the detour.

deviations.why: No new post: extended the existing 2026-11-20 post on the same pool instead, because CLAUDE.md asks for consolidated posts.

notes: Metric: wall time of unwired_checks.run_everything() (the step every ventures-tests job runs; 131 s in CI job 139582466073). Taken in-process on a 4-core container with python3.12 (CI's version), 2 runs each: before 64.4 / 65.4 s, after 58.2 / 60.2 s (-5.7 s, ~9%). Serial sum 243.4 s before. Same 299 result names and exit codes, 0 red. test_unwired_checks: 36 OK on 3.11 and 3.12. Seeded fault (bad spawn cwd in a staged venture test file): suite and check both red. Pool reading: ci_profile --runs 600, 2026-11-25T23:08Z to 2026-11-26T00:07Z, 1279.3 job-min; CodeQL JS analyze is the largest (283.8 min, owner-reviewed priv-codeql.yml), listed for the owner in the history doc.

human_equivalent.basis: profiling a 299-item CI pool, building and verifying a covered-pair map, tests, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
